keyword: is costco closed on easter sunday
claims: Costco is closed on Easter Sunday.
According to Costco’s official holiday schedule, all U.S. warehouse locations are closed in observation of Easter Sunday.
Costco’s closed date for Easter 2026 is Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Costco fuel stations are also closed.
Costco warehouses will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, for normal business hours.
Costco closes for only seven holidays per year.
